{{Quote|Whether by accident, inclination, or misdirection from others, even the most disciplined Force-user eventually steps onto the path that leads to the dark side.|Tolaris Shim in [[3996 BBY]]|<ref name="JVS" />}}
'''Tolaris Shim''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Shim was an active member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Somewhat of a radical amongst their peers, Master Shim firmly believed that all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at some point and in some form or another walked along the path of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. To this end Shim also believed that any Jedi who turned away from the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] was ultimately destined to commit atrocities against the innocent. Furthermore, once said atrocities are committed by the fallen Jedi, Shim believed there could be no redemption, only atonement. The catalyst for Shim's staunch position was the redeemed [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], whom the Jedi Master believed was only eligible for indemnity.

Regardless of Shim's conservative opinions on the subject, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] tasked Master Shim with researching the hows and whys behind a Jedi's fall to the dark side. In [[3996 BBY]], ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before Qel-Droma's [[Death/Legends|death]], Shim completed their research and compiled their findings into ''the Four Stages of the Dark Side''.
